description: This file defines the ViewPopup class for rendering popup views within the SuiteCRM module. It handles loading metadata, view definitions, search definitions, and rendering popup components, including auxiliary UI elements. The class extends SugarView and supports various configurations for list views and search functionalities.

classes.name: ViewPopup
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering popup list views in SuiteCRM, managing metadata, view definitions, and user interactions within popups.
